description: This file defines an API endpoint class for managing 'Nationality' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting nationalities. The class integrates validation rules, API documentation annotations, and interacts with service and model classes to perform its functions.

classes.name: NationalityAPI
classes.description: A RESTful API controller class that provides CRUD operations for the Nationality entity, including endpoints to get, list, create, update, and delete nationalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Nationality record by ID, returning a resource result with the NationalityModel.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Nationalities with pagination and sorting parameters, returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Nationality entity with the provided name.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves the provided Nationality object after setting its name from request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Nationality identified by ID with new data from request.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring length and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationality records specified by ID from request payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, primarily validating the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a Nationality, requiring a max length name.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a Nationality, including unique name validation ignoring current record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, validating IDs.
